story.title: Céline Dion Greeted by Fans in Paris Ahead of Arena Residency
story.summary: Céline Dion was welcomed by fans outside her hotel in Paris as she prepares to launch a 16-show arena residency. This marks her first major concert series since announcing her diagnosis of stiff-person syndrome.

related_stories.title: Norwegian King Harald V Passes Away; Haakon VIII Becomes Monarch
related_stories.summary: King Harald V of Norway has died at the age of 89 after serving as monarch for 35 years. His son, Haakon, has been proclaimed King Haakon VIII, marking the beginning of a new era for the Norwegian monarchy. King Harald was known for his reformist approach and commitment to inclusivity.

related_stories.title: Meta Settles Social Media Addiction Lawsuits for $17 Billion
related_stories.summary: Meta has reached a settlement of up to $17 billion to resolve multistate lawsuits regarding social media addiction. As part of the agreement, the company will implement changes to its platforms, including Facebook and Instagram. The settlement follows extensive negotiations led by state attorneys general amid mounting legal challenges for the tech giant.

related_stories.title: Iceland Votes on Resuming EU Membership Negotiations in Referendum
related_stories.summary: Icelanders are voting in a referendum on whether to resume negotiations for European Union membership. The decision comes after a decade-long suspension of talks, which were halted in 2013 following a shift to a eurosceptic government. The outcome of this referendum is being closely monitored, given its potential implications for Iceland's future relationship with the EU.

related_stories.title: Nepal Flooding Sparks Concerns Over Climate Change Impact on Himalayan Glaciers
related_stories.summary: Recent flooding in Nepal has raised alarms among scientists regarding the accelerating impact of climate change on Himalayan glaciers. While some experts caution against attributing the disaster solely to human-induced climate change, others assert that it exemplifies the catastrophic events they have long predicted. In response to the disaster, India has increased its glacier monitoring efforts to better understand and mitigate the risks posed by rapidly melting glaciers.
